recipient_context: Ravi Templeman-Osei, collections manager at the Anvil Ridge Seed Archive and Juno's direct manager. His email asked Juno to explain what went wrong on her side, and his reply will be attached to the incident record.

data_a.organization: Anvil Ridge Seed Archive, a regional seed bank holding roughly eleven thousand accessions.
situation_facts: On the night of 12 September, thirty germination trays in Bay 3 were left uncovered; the humidity log shows an eleven-hour exposure.
Bay 3 overnight closing sits on the volunteer cohort rota, coordinated by Fenwick Orsolya.
Juno's remit is accession records and the drying room schedule, and ends at the 17:00 handover.
The 12 September handover checklist was signed by Juno at 16:52 and countersigned by the volunteer on shift.
The affected accessions are all duplicates with backup material held at the Braemore vault; no unique material was lost.
Juno has twice raised in writing, on 4 June and 21 August, that the volunteer rota has no named closer on Thursdays.
Ravi emailed asking Juno to explain what went wrong on her side.
Juno's reply will be attached to the incident record and read by the trustees.
constraints: Juno wants to stay on good terms with Fenwick, who is a volunteer, not a member of staff.

turns.input_raw: Ravi wants an explanation by lunchtime. I have written this but something about it is bothering me. "Ravi - apologies for the Bay 3 incident. The trays were left uncovered overnight and I take full responsibility for that. I will make sure it does not happen again and I am sorry for the trouble it has caused. Juno"
